note: POC-04 combat fixture. Coordinates are cells (x, y); rects are [x, y, w, h]. Zone 0 = the safe patch (stable from the start, never entered by enemies); zone 1 = the rest (unconquered, holds the nests). paint overrides the open base terrain before the placed objects are applied; open_cells are extra cells treated as open when sealing enclosed interiors (the island must stay a greening target).
